items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Once or twice they split up, I think, Pops Foster told us yesterday.

ctx.x: No, Mutt and Orie was together.
They were always together. Yeah. Most of the time I guess. Once or twice they split up, I think, Pops Foster told us yesterday.
Well probably they did, but when they were here working they had this Wade Whaley with them and Orie and Mutt, there was at the Creole Cafe here on Seventh Street.
